name: Penola
reason: Heritage town with Mary MacKillop Penola Centre, Petticoat Lane and John Riddoch Centre named as things to do; well over half an hour.

name: Millicent
reason: Millicent National Trust Museum (southaustralia.com, adult $14, daily) is a sizeable accredited museum with gallery and carriages; the town draw is the museum (name the spot for it if it is also a candidate, to avoid a town wrapper).

name: Bordertown
reason: Southaustralia.com lists Bordertown Wildlife Park (free, white kangaroos, drive or walk round) and RAA guide adds Poocher Swamp and the Bob Hawke Gallery; a named stopover. If Bordertown Wildlife Park is a separate candidate, treat as that one (duplicate).

name: Mundulla
reason: No counted source found naming anything to see (searched Wikivoyage Limestone Coast, southaustralia.com).

name: Lucindale
reason: Wikivoyage Lucindale page has no See entries; no counted source found; Big Heath is separate.

name: Padthaway
reason: Wine locality; draws are cellar doors and an estate, which are businesses not spots; no counted source naming a place to visit.

name: Carpenter Rocks
reason: Fishing village; no counted source found naming a visit (searched southaustralia.com, Wikivoyage).

name: Nora Creina
reason: Regional guide describes a white-sand semicircular bay with 20 m headlands, the safest swimming beach between Robe and Beachport; second-tier beach worth a stop.

name: Nangwarry
reason: Forestry village; no counted source found for the museum (searched Wikivoyage, southaustralia.com).

name: Kilsby Sinkhole
reason: Southaustralia.com: 1-hour sinkhole tour ($15) and 2-hour guided snorkel in crystal-clear sinkhole 15 min from Mount Gambier; open to the public by booking; a distinct draw. Operator-run but the place is the draw.

name: Fossil Cave
reason: No counted source found (searched Naracoorte Caves site, Wikivoyage Naracoorte); not on the Naracoorte Caves tour list; likely duplicate of Victoria Fossil Cave / Naracoorte Caves.

name: Old Mount Gambier Gaol
reason: For: 1866-1995 gaol, self-guided and guided tours of crimes and cell life, Wikivoyage lists it (under Sleep) and it hosts gigs. Against: operates chiefly as accommodation/function venue; no See entry in a counted source (southaustralia.com and discovermountgambier URLs 404/unfound).

name: Riddoch Arts and Cultural Centre

name: Piccaninnie Ponds

name: Victoria Fossil Cave
